title: Budget controller config (models-budget.md; M3-01, FR-13, NFR-05)
description: Per-object or per-task spending envelope. Limits are checked before every LLM / compute / paid call; at 100% of any limit the task stops with partial artifacts (invariant 5). Paid calls are disabled by default and enabling them needs a recorded approval (ADR-017/ADR-021). Usage is computed from .rh/model-calls.jsonl and adapter request logs; any unknown usage makes the state unknown, never ok (NFR-05).

enabled_by.description: Approval id (e.g. AR-0001) that authorises paid calls. Required in practice whenever paid_calls is enabled; the controller blocks paid calls when it is absent.

thresholds.description: Fractions of each limit that raise findings; the default is [0.5, 0.8, 1.0] (registry #22).
